title: WHERE SAFETY ENDS *Remake
notes: This is an example of a Unity game where the macOS build fails to launch (perhaps not compatible with macOS 27) and the Windows build still launchable so I'm happy to still be able to explore this game! It is defaulting to a resolution of 1754x1240 and there are no setting to change it so it is overlapping into my laptop screen at the bottom: is there a way to force resolution changes? It's technically playable (seems to be a visual novel like) but some things (ie. reading profiles) get cropped off so would love to fix this. I tried to check "Emulate display mode changes" to see if it would do anything but it doesn't let me check the box...
issues: resolution goes beyond borders of primary screen (1754x1240)
